categories.name: Nature
categories.description: Coasts, dunes, mountains and the sky.

categories.name: Travel

categories.name: Ocean

items.caption: Last light on the west coast with @mira.sails 🌅 #sunset #run #coast
items.summary: A sunset run along the cliffs to the lighthouse with Mira.

people.description: woman in a red windbreaker running ahead
the account owner, filming and speaking off camera

events.text: Start of the run on the cliff path
Camera pans to the sun on the horizon

speech.transcript: Okay, last kilometre. Look at that light. Mira, slow down! … We made it before the sun went down.

analysis.music: Golden Hour Drive - The Paper Kites (sample)
analysis.what: Two people run along a cliff path at sunset toward a lighthouse. The camera turns to the sea as the sun touches the horizon, and the runner ahead waves at the end.
analysis.context: Part of a running series: the on-screen "Day 12" counts days of a coastal trip that earlier posts started.

items.description: Two people run along a cliff path at sunset toward a lighthouse. The camera turns to the sea as the sun touches the horizon, and the runner ahead waves at the end. It was sunset at Cape Lumen Lighthouse, Portugal. Part of a running series: the on-screen "Day 12" counts days of a coastal trip that earlier posts started.

items.caption: Three days, one city, too many stairs. Thanks @leo.maps for the tour #citywalk #architecture
items.alt_text: Photo 1: a blue evening street; photo 2: a pink tiled wall; photo 3: rooftops at night.
items.summary: A three-photo walk through the old town with Leo as guide.

people.description: man in a grey cap pointing at a doorway

analysis.what: A carousel of a city walk: a steep blue street at dusk, a wall of pink tiles, and rooftops after dark.
analysis.context: Second stop of the same coastal trip as the sunset reel.

items.description: A carousel of a city walk: a steep blue street at dusk, a wall of pink tiles, and rooftops after dark. It was evening at Alfama, Lisbon, Portugal. Second stop of the same coastal trip as the sunset reel.

items.summary: A story from the dunes asking followers to vote: sandboard or walk.

analysis.what: A wide shot of orange dunes under a yellow sky with a poll sticker.
analysis.context: Poll story; the next story in the Travel highlight shows the answer.

items.description: A wide shot of orange dunes under a yellow sky with a poll sticker. It was midday at Dunas Altas, Portugal. Poll story; the next story in the Travel highlight shows the answer.

repost_of.author: oceanlab
repost_of.caption: Bioluminescent plankton lighting up the bay last night. Sound on. #ocean #science

items.summary: A story sharing Ocean Lab's reel of glowing plankton in a bay.

people.description: the original reel's author, a marine science account

events.text: Shared reel appears in the story frame

analysis.what: The owner shares a reel by @oceanlab of plankton glowing blue in a dark bay, with a mention sticker.
analysis.context: A share, not the owner's own footage; credited to @oceanlab.

items.description: The owner shares a reel by @oceanlab of plankton glowing blue in a dark bay, with a mention sticker. The original is by @oceanlab. A share, not the owner's own footage; credited to @oceanlab.

items.caption: Sunday bowl: roasted squash, chili oil, too much coriander. Recipe in the reel. #food #homecooking
items.summary: A bowl of roasted squash with chili oil, cooked at home.

analysis.what: Top-down photo of a bowl of roasted squash, rice and herbs on a wooden table.
analysis.context: Pairs with the cooking reel that shows the recipe.

items.description: Top-down photo of a bowl of roasted squash, rice and herbs on a wooden table. It was lunch at home kitchen. Pairs with the cooking reel that shows the recipe.

items.summary: A walk through a covered market past fruit stalls.

people.description: a stall keeper in a green apron

events.text: Pan up to the iron roof

analysis.what: The camera walks between fruit stalls in a covered market.
analysis.context: In both the Travel and Food highlights.

items.description: The camera walks between fruit stalls in a covered market. It was at Mercado Central, Portugal. In both the Travel and Food highlights.

items.caption: This is the climb we're doing next month. Who's in? 🏔 (via @mountainclub)

repost_of.author: mountainclub
repost_of.caption: The north ridge in two frames. Route notes in our bio.

items.summary: A repost of Mountain Club's north-ridge photos, inviting friends to the climb.

analysis.what: A repost of a two-photo post about a mountain ridge route, with the owner's invitation in the caption.
analysis.context: Plans for a climb next month.

items.description: A repost of a two-photo post about a mountain ridge route, with the owner's invitation in the caption. It was at north ridge (unnamed). The original is by @mountainclub. Plans for a climb next month.

items.caption: The squash bowl, start to finish in 10 seconds #recipe #food
items.summary: A fast recipe reel for roasted squash with chili oil.

people.description: hands of the cook, a ring on the left hand

speech.transcript: Squash, olive oil, salt. Two-twenty for thirty-five minutes. Rice, squash, chili oil, way too much coriander. Done.

analysis.what: A sped-up recipe: squash is cut, roasted, plated on rice and finished with chili oil.
analysis.context: The recipe for the Sunday bowl post.

items.description: A sped-up recipe: squash is cut, roasted, plated on rice and finished with chili oil. The recipe for the Sunday bowl post.

items.caption: Studio day: a photo and a tiny film #studio #music
items.summary: A photo and a short clip from a day in a music studio.

analysis.what: A purple-lit studio photo followed by a five-second clip of the mixing desk.
analysis.context: Mixed media carousel: image then video.

items.description: A purple-lit studio photo followed by a five-second clip of the mixing desk. It was at recording studio. Mixed media carousel: image then video.
